subject: accordion-eared hare
art_direction: 两只手风琴折耳一高一低，黑色小兔穿亮橙宽围领，姿态像准备谢幕。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Draw a compact black hare whose enormous ears bend like folded accordion bellows, one upright and the other curled over. It wears a bright orange circular ruff and rests one paw against its chest in a tiny theatrical bow. Keep the face small and solemn, with a short mouth and uneven eyebrow rhythm. Use three large printed color areas with slight ink grain, not glossy shading. Place the creature against pale blue-gray. Let the zigzag ear edges contrast with its rounded torso and short broad feet. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
